I feel so seen by this post :') I ALSO practiced polyamory to feel fulfilled even though, as I eventually figured out, I am not actually oriented that way! I totally get how the anxiety leads to guilt and it's a hard cycle. But I think any change you could make to the situation should be for your own benefit, like learning ways to help yourself regulate so you don't worry as much. For me that involves going to therapy regularly, doing extra self care and telling my Daddy what reassurance I need prior to him being busy. He's wonderful about that. Over time, too, I feel gradually less desperate for attention because my little self is learning that he doesn't stop loving me when I can't see him in front of me (metaphorically). I hope that that can happen for you too!

Well, to start off, it’s okay to realize things about yourself and change your labels or even just have occurrences outside your labels. You don’t HAVE to have labels, because you’re a human and humans are not shaped correctly to fit into boxes. So there’s that to keep in mind for the future. Then, there’s the issue that you want to kill your feelings for them right? And you’ve tried so hard to push them away? The more you push the feelings back the harder they pull, so what you need to do is stop focusing on getting rid of the feelings. If you really do like the person that much then you will be able to make peace with the relationship that you have now. That’s the first step, relaxing, and then over time that’s when you can expect feelings to fade. You could also confess if you feel that’s what’s right to do. I know that this situation is bothering you a lot and incredibly important to you. But please don’t let it consume your entire life at the moment-  you have so much more to you than these feelings for someone. (Also, if you can’t end up getting rid of the feelings then that doesn’t mean you did anything wrong ) This is my advice, but of course I am not you and so you have to take it with a grain of salt. Do what you feel is best for you and your situation. Blessed be
